raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":139,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT vc.company_name, COUNT(DISTINCT v.vehicle_id) AS hazmat_vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company vc JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON vc.company_id = v.company_id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict vtd ON v.vehicle_type_code = vtd.type_code JOIN common.administrative_division ad ON vc.area_id = ad.id WHERE ad.province_name = '四川省' AND vtd.type_name = '危化品车' GROUP BY vc.company_id, vc.company_name ORDER BY hazmat_vehicle_count DESC;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"查询四川省的危化品车辆公司分布","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vehicle_company","MYSQL:transportation.vehicle","MYSQL:common.vehicle_type_dict","MYSQL:common.administrative_division"],"columns":["company_name","vehicle_id","type_name","province_name"]}],"assumptions":["危化品车辆通过车辆类型字典中 type_name='危化品车' 识别","四川省通过行政区划表 province_name='四川省' 识别","公司分布按公司名称分组并统计危化品车辆数量"]}
